master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a BRAND NEW vehicle illustration, not a repaint of an SUV or pickup. Subject: a medium professional 6x6 OFF-ROAD BREAKDOWN RECOVERY TRUCK, approximately 9.5m long, 14 tonnes, facing RIGHT, three axles, red work truck carrying its own folded recovery crane and towing apparatus. Design a HIGH COMMERCIAL TRUCK CAB with upright flat windshield, tall squared two-door cab, visible roof above driver's head, heavy exposed steps and a SHORT SLOPING BONNET. It must clearly read as a real medium-duty industrial 6x6 truck, NOT a Jeep/G-Wagon/pickup with extra wheels. Signal red/brick-scarlet painted metal, slim ivory safety bands, black utility chassis and bumpers. Rear LEFT and middle have substantial practical locker body with brushed steel latches, coiled recovery gear and a compact stowed hydraulic KNUCKLE-BOOM lying LOW over the bed, its two folded arms neatly nested horizontally. The crane is not huge and does not dominate the whole roofline. Towing winch DRUM exposed at LEFT REAR of the body, cable neatly wound and a heavy visible hook at the rear fairlead, folded ground spades, rear underlift extends LEFT. Rugged dark charcoal deep-tread mud-terrain tires, visibly dark rubber, only light dry earth in recesses, matching black steel multi-hole rims, restrained metallic hubs. Tiny amber lamps are UNLIT, no glow. Premium semi-realistic PAINTED GAME ILLUSTRATION, crisp natural dark outlines, finely painted bolts/hinges/hoses, rich weathered materials, same quality as the attached Swamp Scout style reference, but NEW TRUCK BODY and red color. Softer coherent daylight, no hard cast shadow. True transparent alpha background, no ground or drop shadow, colored fringe, halo, scenery, text, branding or watermark. Camera side-on facing right with very restrained elevation, a little roof and equipment deck visible. CANVAS AND REGISTRATION: exactly 1774x887 PNG, near road wheel outer circles radius160px centered at (575,688), (905,688), (1585,688). Every axle uses same tire size. These three positions must remain EXACT because existing animation uses them. Body spans roughly x300..1740; rear underlift may extend left to x45. Keep all equipment inside x35..1740 and y75..855 with transparent margins. Short cab at right spans approximately x1190..1600, short bonnet to x1730, compact folded crane on the LEFT utility deck roughly x390..1110. Complete vehicle WITH all road wheels, any visible far-side tires same size. The attached olive Scout supplies STYLE ONLY, not its SUV shape or its colors.
